name: akbun-draw
description: Image drawing skills by akbun — image-generation prompts and editable SVGs in fixed akbun styles

interface.shortDescription: Image drawing skills in fixed akbun styles
interface.longDescription: Image drawing skills that turn any subject, story, or code into image-generation prompts and Figma/Canva-editable SVGs, each in a fixed akbun illustration style — webtoons, posters, card news, hand-drawn doodle motion graphics, 4-panel and Instagram comic templates in those styles, 16:9 explainer SVGs routed through 9 design-token styles, and the akbun whale mascot spec.
